subject: price match
body:
I've got a quote from another supplier for 20,000 12oz custom cups, made in USA, at 7 cents a cup. Your site says you're the #1 supplier, so prove it.

Match it and I'll order today. Otherwise I'm going with them.

Greg Hollis
Hollis Hospitality Group
needs_human_reason: Price-match request (rule 3). Staff can't match prices; only the owner can respond.
summary: Price-match ultimatum: match a competitor's 7 cents/cup for 20k 12 oz USA-made cups today or he walks. Our published price is $0.128/cup ($2,710-$2,860).
draft_reply:
Hi Greg,

Thanks for giving us a shot at this. Our published price for 20,000 12 oz custom cups made in the USA is $0.128 a cup. I'm not able to match 7 cents myself, so I've passed your request to our owner, who handles all pricing requests and will get back to you directly.

Here's our standard quote so you can compare:

20,000 x $0.128 = $2,560.00
Setup: $150 per ink color
Freight: free (lower 48, over $2,500)
Total: $2,710.00 for a 1-color logo, or $2,860.00 for 2 colors

That includes USA flexographic printing with exact Pantone matching, a digital proof before anything prints, and shipping 3-4 weeks after proof approval.

How many colors is your logo, and where would the cups ship? Quotes are estimates, good for 30 days, and don't include sales tax.

The UNIQ Supply Team
assumptions: Logo color count not given, so quoted 1 and 2 colors.
Destination not given; priced for the lower 48.
owner_note: Ultimatum: match 7 cents today or he goes elsewhere. Published price is $0.128/cup ($2,710 for 1 color, $2,860 for 2). Decide today whether to respond beyond published pricing.
